title: Lexicon Board Scanner
description: Given a 2D grid of characters and a list of dictionary words, find all words that can be constructed from letters of sequentially adjacent cells, where adjacent cells are horizontally or vertically neighboring. Each cell's letter may be used only once per word.
constraints: board[i][j] is a lowercase English letter.
words[i] consists of lowercase English letters.
All values of words are unique.
input_format: A 2D character grid (board) and a list of strings (words).
output_format: A list of strings containing all words found in the board.

examples.explanation: Both 'eat' and 'oath' can be traced out using adjacent grid cells without reusing a cell within the same word.
Cannot reuse the same cell ('b') multiple times in a single word path.
A 1x1 board containing 'a' matches the word 'a'.
